# Epinoia Horizon

> Epinoia Horizon builds Merlin, an open-source AI agent harness that lives in your terminal:
> persistent memory, loadable skills, tool execution, and 3D/WebGL capabilities, installable with one command.

## Product
- [Merlin Agent](https://epinoiahorizon.com/): the harness — install, memory, skills, tools, model routing.
- [Pricing](https://epinoiahorizon.com/pricing/): tiers and what each unlocks.
- [Documentation](https://epinoiahorizon.com/docs/): install and usage guides.
- [Terminal tutorial](https://epinoiahorizon.com/docs/tutorial-merlin-terminal.html): step-by-step walkthrough.
- [Install script](https://epinoiahorizon.com/install.sh): one-command installer.

## Writing
- [What is an AI agent harness?](https://epinoiahorizon.com/blog/what-is-an-ai-agent-harness.html)
- [Make money with open-source AI agents](https://epinoiahorizon.com/blog/make-money-with-open-source-ai-agents.html)

## Source
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/epinoiahorizon/Merlin-Agent)
- [Landing site source](https://github.com/epinoiahorizon/grimoire-landing)

## Facts
- License: MIT. Free to self-host.
- Runs on Linux, macOS and Windows (WSL).
- Merlin is model-agnostic: OpenAI-compatible providers, local models, or hosted gateways.
